description: Create private illustrated storybooks from your ideas, follow generation progress, and read stories saved in your PictureBooks account. Built for parents, caregivers, educators, and other adult authors. Connect your existing account to check available credits and create books using those credits. The plugin does not purchase credits, charge a card, or publish your books. You can disconnect access in PictureBooks at any time.

defaultPrompt: Create a five-page bedtime story about a shy dragon.
How many PictureBooks credits do I have?
